parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the interactive messaging application.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the message group.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description:
The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

Valid values: 1 to 100000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of members to return on each page. Default value: 20.

Valid values: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: SortType
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

*   0: ascending order by time
*   1: descending order by time

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live list-message-group-user --app-id VKL3000 --group-id AE35-0000-T95F --sort-type 1 --page-num 10 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
